```artifact
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm
    Given the system is running
    And the average leakage over X seconds is 3.1 L/min
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the "high leakage" alarm is active
    And the alarm priority is 1 (high)

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm - Edge Case
    Given the system is running
    And the average leakage over X seconds is 3 L/min
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the "high leakage" alarm is not active
    And the alarm priority is 0 (low)

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm - Invalid Value
    Given the system is running
    And the average leakage over X seconds is -1 L/min
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then an error message is displayed
    And the alarm is not active

  Scenario: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm
    Given the system is running
    And the system is shutting down
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the "involuntary shutdown" alarm is active
    And the alarm tone is continuous

  Scenario: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm - Duration
    Given the system is running
    And the system is shutting down
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the alarm tone duration is >= 2 minutes

  Scenario: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm
    Given the system is running
    And the AC mains power is lost
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the "AC mains power loss" alarm is active
    And the alarm priority is 2 (medium)

  Scenario: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm - Sensor Connection
    Given the system is running
    And the AC mains power sensor is connected
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the "AC mains power loss" alarm is active
    And the alarm priority is 2 (medium)

  Scenario Outline: Alarm Priority
    Given the system is running
    And the alarm type is <alarm_type>
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the alarm priority is <priority>

    Examples:
      | alarm_type | priority |
      | high leakage | 1 (high) |
      | involuntary shutdown | 1 (high) |
      | AC mains power loss | 2 (medium) |

  Scenario Outline: Average Leakage
    Given the system is running
    And the average leakage over X seconds is <leakage>
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the "high leakage" alarm is <active>

    Examples:
      | leakage | active |
      | 3.1 L/min | active |
      | 3 L/min | not active |
      | -1 L/min | not active |
```
